name: Initial Skeleton Extraction via Parallel-Plane Sets
aliases: Grid Representation as Union of Parallel-plane Sets
definition: The multi-resolution tetrahedral grid is represented as a union of parallel-plane sets. Unique normals $\mathcal{N} = \{\mathbf{n}_0, \dots\}$ are identified, and for each normal $\mathbf{n}_i$, a vector of offsets $\mathbf{d}^{(i)} = [d_0^{(i)}, d_1^{(i)}, \dots]^\top$ is stored across all resolution levels.
